trace_steps: Step 1 frame_retriever returns candidate frames at 69.0s, 80.0s, and 81.0s for the original question screen. Step 2 OCR reads the same stemplot content across these frames — title text "STEMPLOTS" and rows "4 | 0013555678", "5 | 1124444555555667789", and "6 | 01159" — so I use this retrieved bundle as the first stemplot in its unsolved state.

From Step 2 OCR on the retrieved frames, the first stemplot rows are: stem 4 with leaves "0013555678", stem 5 with leaves "1124444555555667789", and stem 6 with leaves "01159". Interpreting stem-and-leaf values gives the ordered data: 40, 40, 41, 43, 45, 45, 45, 46, 47, 48; 51, 51, 52, 54, 54, 54, 54, 55, 55, 55, 55, 55, 55, 56, 56, 57, 57, 58, 59; 60, 61, 61, 65, 69.
Using the OCR transcription from Step 2, the full dataset has 10 + 19 + 5 = 34 values. After removing all leaves with value 3 from the relevant stem, the count decreases by the number of such leaves.

Step 2 OCR shows no stem 13 in the visible first stemplot; the visible stems are only 4, 5, and 6. Under the standard stem-and-leaf interpretation of this displayed plot, removing all leaves '3' from the row with stem 4 removes the single value 43, because OCR reads "4 | 0013555678" and that row contains exactly one leaf 3.

After deleting 43 from the OCR-derived ordered list, 33 values remain. For 33 numbers, the median is the 17th value. Counting through the ordered OCR list after removing 43 gives positions 1–9 as 40, 40, 41, 45, 45, 45, 46, 47, 48 and positions 10–28 as 51, 51, 52, 54, 54, 54, 54, 55, 55, 55, 55, 55, 55, 56, 56, 57, 57, 58, 59, so the 17th value is 54.

The OCR-grounded computation gives a new median of 54, but 54 is not among the provided options A–E (124, 122, 121, 123, 119). Because the only retrieved first stemplot frames show stems 4, 5, and 6 rather than a stem 13, the option cannot be verified from the available tool evidence.
